component.name: gallery-dl
component.summary: Download image galleries and collections from the command line

description.p: gallery-dl downloads image galleries and collections from many image hosting sites. It supports custom filenames, download archives, authentication, and filtering.

This community Flatpak package offers optional add-ons for video downloads, SOCKS proxies, compressed web responses, configuration formats, browser keyrings, PostgreSQL archives, system certificates, and templates.
